# testing_import_multiple_id_acronym (Resource)

ImportMultipleIDAcronym Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_import_multiple_id_acronym" "my_importmultipleidacronym" {
  api_id                = "...my_api_id..."
  portal_id             = "...my_portal_id..."
  request_body_property = "...my_request_body_property..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_id` (String) API acronym for regression testing
- `portal_id` (String)

### Optional

- `request_body_property` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_import_multiple_id_acronym.my_testing_import_multiple_id_acronym
  id = jsonencode({
    api_id    = "..."
    portal_id = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_import_multiple_id_acronym.my_testing_import_multiple_id_acronym '{"api_id": "...", "portal_id": "..."}'
```
